The issuer shows strong profitability (EBIT margin ~33% and net margin ~21%) and solid capitalization (shareholders’ equity of 7,253M against total assets of 15,011M). However, liquidity is weak with current assets of 1,047M below current liabilities of 1,322M (current ratio ~0.79), creating refinancing/near-term funding risk despite manageable overall leverage.

DECISION: BBB-
